sents.en: Many people ride in cars every day.
Cars get people from one place to another.
sents.ko: 자동차는 사람을 한 곳에서 다른 곳으로 데려다줘요.

sents.en: Cars have a body and four wheels.
sents.ko: 자동차에는 차체와 바퀴 네 개가 있어요.

sents.en: The steering wheel turns the wheels.
The engine powers the car.
The seats and controls are inside the car.
sents.ko: 좌석과 조작 장치는 차 안에 있어요.

sents.en: The seat belts and air bags keep you safe.
sents.ko: 안전벨트와 에어백이 우리를 안전하게 지켜 줘요.

sents.en: The headlights help the driver see at night.
sents.ko: 전조등은 운전자가 밤에 볼 수 있게 도와줘요.

sents.en: Most cars need fuel to run.
They run on gas or diesel.
Some cars are electric.
They run on a battery that is charged by electricity.
Some cars are called hybrids.
They often run on gas or diesel and a battery.
Smart cars are often used in the city.
They are small and easy to park.
Police cars have special lights and sirens.
These help others know the police car is coming.
sents.ko: 그래서 다른 사람들이 경찰차가 오는 걸 알 수 있어요.

sents.en: Oh, the story is over already.
Cars have many small parts.
And there are many different kinds of cars.
What type of car would you like to drive?
sents.ko: 여러분은 어떤 자동차를 운전해 보고 싶나요?

sents.en: I'm curious to know. So, tell me later.
I'll see you next time. Good-bye!
